verdict.rationale: Okta exposes Admin Management APIs that its official MCP server wraps for operations such as creating users, adding them to groups, and querying failed logins. The developer site documents API rate limits and offers a free Integrator plan to 'manage and automate Okta', which shows a public, programmable API surface. Missing for 10: a direct citation of the API reference docs themselves, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), and llms.txt/markdown docs for agent consumption.
